title: Angelus, 22 November 2026, Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe
pray: My thoughts and prayers go out to the people of Papua New Guinea and other Pacific countries affected by drought.

Let us pray for the victims of the many conflicts that, unfortunately, continue to sow death and suffering throughout the world; and for those in positions of responsibility, that they may commit themselves without delay to finding solutions for reconciliation and peace.
